::: {#thm-ols-slr}
#### Closed-form OLS estimates

Write

$$
\begin{aligned}
S_{xx} &\eqdef \sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \bar{x})^2, &
S_{yy} &\eqdef \sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \bar{y})^2, &
S_{xy} &\eqdef \sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \bar{x})(y_i - \bar{y}),
\end{aligned}
$$

and suppose $S_{xx} > 0$ (not all $x_i$ are equal).
Then the OLS estimates (@def-ols) are unique, and

$$\hcoef{x} = \frac{S_{xy}}{S_{xx}},
\qquad \hintcoef = \bar{y} - \hcoef{x} \bar{x}.$$
:::
